fields.statement: At 161f5f5 (the fix adding daemon --permission-mode), go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-.*|describe-golden)$' -count=1 passes, and go test ./... passes. In daemon-picks.txtar's kept work dir, the fake Rex's rex.log has exactly one new tab per daemon --once poll: 'rex window new 01M5PWGQ8 -c <repo> --json -- <rhiza> run start 01M5PWGQ8GB4618G4RH2TV0ZAH --permission-mode manual'. That is the Built change set's ID with no --autonomous, and the leafless and backlog change sets got no tab. Under daemon --once --autonomous the line ends '--permission-mode manual --autonomous'. The daemon now also needs --permission-mode, which the QA blocker asked for: without it, or with bypassPermissions, it exits non-zero and opens no tab (asserted by '! exists rex.log'). The script's ID assertion is the regex [0-9A-Z]*, which would also match an empty ID, so I read the log by hand to confirm the ID. make self-check fails only on stale .rhiza/rendered files, not on code.
